name: zyvora
description: ZYVORA — Premium Car/Bike Flag E-Commerce. Monorepo per E1.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @zyvora/web & npm run dev -w @zyvora/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @zyvora/api && npm run build -w @zyvora/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zyvora/types && npm run typecheck -w @zyvora/ui && npm run typecheck -w @zyvora/api && npm run typecheck -w @zyvora/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @zyvora/ui && npm run lint -w @zyvora/api && npm run lint -w @zyvora/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
